svg.title: Workload and institutional clocks have different scales

Keep the scripted evidence boundary and lettering visible.", "lettering": [ { "box": [ 0.045, 0.78, 0.91, 0.18 ] } ], "lettering_mode": "manual", "nodes": [ { "asset": "clock", "box": [ 0.20810533333333336, 0.2882, 0.08533333333333334, 0.12800000000000003 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "WORKLOAD TIME", "label_box": [ 0.09640000000000001, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "clock", "box": [ 0.5610386666666667, 0.22419999999999998, 0.1706666666666667, 0.25600000000000006 ], "color": "steel", "focus": true, "label": "INSTITUTIONAL TIME", "label_box": [ 0.492, 0.4862, 0.308744, 0.085 ] }, { "asset": "boundary", "box": [ 0.4908, 0.0962, 0.01656, 0.5376 ], "color": "amber" } ], "reconstructed": false, "shot": "split", "source": "
**Frame:** Two clocks. The left one measures a workload. The right one measures organizational and geopolitical time. Their scales do not match and are drawn so that the mismatch is the first thing read. Beneath each, the reach of a unilateral stop: on the left it cannot erase the shared artifacts already posted; on the right it cannot halt capability diffusion elsewhere.

**Caption:**
> EACH DECISION IS DEFENSIBLE AT THE SCALE OF THE DECIDER.
>
> NO DECIDER IS AT THE SCALE OF THE RESULT.

**Provenance:** `inferred` — structural comparison.

", "title": "Workload and institutional clocks have different scales" } }
